home.heroTitle: Learn something worth knowing in a quiet, scholarly study
home.heroSubtitle: A classic bilingual course platform with protected video delivery, paper-ink aesthetics, and blazing performance.
home.description: A bilingual course platform with protected video delivery.
home.feature1Desc: Adaptive HLS video chunking and short-lived signed authorization tokens prevent unauthorized downloads or URL sharing.
home.feature2Desc: 100% serverless deployment (Vercel + Neon + Upstash Redis) delivers sub-second response times with zero idle compute costs.
home.feature3Desc: Strict logical CSS, normalized Arabic full-text search with typo tolerance, and classical calligraphic typography.
